title: Legal Sports Betting Linked To Food Insecurity, Study Finds
summary_or_snippet: GamblingHarm.org reported on an NBER study that linked legal sports-betting access to lower food sufficiency among some U.S. households, with larger declines among working-age adults without a college degree, adults ages 25 to 44, and non-white adults. The article said researchers identified financial stress as the main mechanism and drew on Census Bureau Household Pulse Survey data.
